notes.zh: 勘察天体时，隐藏事件 ancrel.9999（on_survey_planet）以 5/405 的机会生成一个随机考古遗址（AI帝国或5年内刚发现过遗址者机会×0.2），再按各遗址的权重抽取；本遗址要求拥有《远古遗物》，权重20，出现在贫瘠或寒冷贫瘠星球（没有“地形改造候选”修正）上。拥有《利维坦》时权重×2。遗址创建时清除星球资源点并加上“远古玻璃化星球”修正。
notes.en: When a body is surveyed, hidden ancrel.9999 (on_survey_planet) has a 5/405 chance to create a random dig site (×0.2 for AI empires or if a site was found in the last 5 years), then picks a site type by weight; this site needs Ancient Relics and has weight 20 on barren or cold barren planets without the terraforming_candidate modifier. With Leviathans the weight is doubled. On creation the planet's deposits are cleared and the modifier ancient_glassed_planet is added.

scope.zh: 整条故事：遗址的出现方式、全部阶段（按定义顺序）、最后结果及其互斥关系、掷骰失败时的事件池；中英文正文已读。
scope.en: Whole story: how the site appears, every stage in definition order, the final outcome(s) and their exclusivity, the roll-failure incident pool; both languages read.
